name: Inspire Robots RH56DFX
mpn: RH56DFX-2L / RH56DFX-2R (hand only); RH56DFXW-2L / RH56DFXW-2R (with 2-DOF wrist)
description: Five-finger dexterous hand with 12 joints and 6 DOF driven by 6 internal micro linear servo actuators, with per-finger force sensors and RS485 control.

specs.label: DOF / actuators
specs.value: 6 DOF, 12 joints, 6 micro linear servo actuators (+2 DOF wrist on DFXW)

specs.label: Fingertip force
specs.value: Thumb 15 N, four fingers 10 N each; force resolution 0.5 N

specs.label: Speed
specs.value: Four-finger flexion 260°/s; thumb flexion 70°/s; thumb lateral rotation 107°/s (>65° range)

specs.label: Power
specs.value: DC 12–48 V (product page); 24 V in the RH56 series manual; quiescent 0.09 A @ 24 V, peak 2 A @ 24 V

specs.label: Control interface
specs.value: RS485 (Modbus-RTU style register protocol, 115200 bps default); CAN variants are sold by resellers; GX12 aviation connector

envelope.axes: x = palm width, y = palm thickness as dimensioned in the side view, z = overall length from base flange to middle fingertip (fingers straight); thumb sticks out beyond x and y and is not given as an overall size

features.label: Overall length
features.source: RH56 Series User Manual V1.0.9, Fig. 1 'Construction and Dimensions', p.1

features.label: Palm width / thickness
features.value: 80.7 mm across the knuckles; 31.2 mm palm thickness

features.label: Finger segments
features.value: Distal segment 49.3 mm, middle segment 32.0 mm (side view)

features.label: Mounting interface
features.value: Round wrist base Ø52.0 mm OD with a Ø38.0 mm circle; bottom view shows 4 holes at 90° spacing. Hole size and thread aren't dimensioned. Ø12.0 mm GX12 cable connector on the back of the wrist. No ISO 9409 flange.
features.source: RH56 Series User Manual Fig. 1 (bottom view)

features.label: Stroke / finger travel
features.value: Given as angle registers (ANGLE_SET 0–1000) in the manual; no mm stroke published for the hand

features.label: Wrist (DFXW)
features.value: Yaw ±27° (manual: −25.50° to 25.50°), pitch ±22° (manual: −22.66° to 22.12°), 2 N·m load torque excluding hand

notes: Dimensions come from the generic 'RH56 Series' manual (V1.0.9, Jan 2024), which covers the DF (10/15 N) and BF (4/6 N) builds. Its figure isn't labelled for the DFX specifically, so confirm against a DFX drawing from Inspire. Voltage conflicts: 24 V (manual) vs DC 12–48 V (current product page). Speed: 260°/s four-finger flexion on the official page; one reseller (AIFIT Lab) lists 570°/s. The base holes are visible but not dimensioned. No Amazon listing; US resellers include Knox Labs and RobotShop.
